newsitem.title: USA: N.Y.'s Bruno sets news conference on office fire.
newsitem.headline: N.Y.'s Bruno sets news conference on office fire.

text.p: New York State Senate Majority Leader Joseph Bruno, R-Troy, who has launched a controversial plan to end rent controls, plans to brief reporters at 1100 EDT about a fire in his district office.
A spokesman for Bruno told reporters in Albany that the briefing would cover a fire that broke out last night in the senator's district office in Saratoga.
The spokesman added Bruno had received bomb threats and death threats since he proposed phasing out state rules for rent-regulated apartments that mainly affect New York City.
